newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine soybeans down in good-volume trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine soybeans down in good-volume trade.

text.p: Argentine cash soybeans slipped in good-volume trade at Buenos Aires Cereals Exchnage Wednesday, reflecting sales by crushers on the futures market, traders said.

FAS elevator soybeans lost $4 in Rosario to $280. Sunflower seed also fell as crushers sold, losing $4 in Rosario to $226. FAS elevator maize was steady at $108 in Buenos Aires, with good volume turnover and farmers providing plenty of supply. Wheat was steady at $145 in Quequen in quiet trade, but with a little more buying interest from exporters.
